title: A complete mind cycles through explore, consolidate and persist

statements.text: The octopus explores through parallel autonomous probes, the cetacean consolidates shared knowledge across a group, and the human persists knowledge in external form. A complete mind, biological or artificial, needs all three as phases of one cycle.

sources.quote: every complete mind requires three cognitive modes: octopus (explore), cetacean (consolidate), human (persist)
